messages:
Maria (Ops): @channel Incident declared: API latencies spiked across eu-west and us-west, sustained error rate ~12% for POST /v1/generate. Paging oncall now. :rotating_light:
IncidentBot: Paging Sanjay (Oncall) — escalation level: P1 — pager sent to primary oncall. Logs and traces: https://redwood.traces/incident/1903456789
Sanjay (Oncall): On it. Taking initial triage. Can someone confirm customer-visible impact?
Jamie (Support): Seeing increase in priority tickets, some customers reporting timeouts in the UI, a handful of downstream retries. Estimate affected sessions ~3-4% of active keys, but a few large customers impacted.
Maria (Ops): Stack shows overloaded kv-cache misses during peak batching windows. Fallback routing not kicking in for some requests.
Alex (Comms): Starting a comms thread — need a short status page blurb + public tweet draft. Who needs to approve? Legal? Execs?
Elaine (Legal): I can scan for compliance wording. For now avoid specifics about root cause until we have confirmation. Keep it factual: impact, mitigation steps, ETA for next update.
Sanjay (Oncall): Mitigation: rolling applied a routing policy to divert to regional spare capacity, reducing errors to ~4% now. Still seeing higher latency for long sequences.
Jamie (Support): Put a pinned note in support queue: "We are investigating elevated POST /v1/generate errors; workaround: reduce request concurrency and retry with exponential backoff."
Alex (Comms): Draft status page update (short):

```
We are experiencing elevated errors and latency for text generation in eu-west and us-west. A subset of requests may receive timeouts or degraded responses. Engineers are investigating and mitigation is in progress (traffic is being routed to spare capacity). We will provide another update within 30 minutes.
```

Sanjay (Oncall): That matches current state. Suggest add: "No evidence of data loss."

Alex (Comms): Updated draft with that line. Draft tweet options (short, choose 1):
1) "Experiencing elevated errors for text generation in some regions. Engineers are mitigating — no evidence of data loss. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai — updates in 30m."
2) "We’re investigating higher latency and timeouts for parts of our text generation API in eu-west/us-west. Mitigation underway and traffic is being routed. Status: https://status.redwood.ai"
3) "Mitigating partial outage impacting text gen in EU/US regions. Support: https://support.redwood.ai. Will update shortly."

Elaine (Legal): Prefer option 2. Clear, region-specific, no speculative cause. Avoid the word "outage."

Maria (Ops): Ops + oncall recommend option 1 or 2. Option 2 is fine. Also can we add a line in the status page about affected endpoints (/v1/generate) and suggested customer workaround?

Alex (Comms): Status page expanded draft:

```
Incident started: 2026-03-15T14:46:29Z
Affected services: Text generation API (POST /v1/generate) in eu-west and us-west
Impact: Some requests may experience increased latency or timeouts; a subset of customers may see degraded responses.
Mitigation: Traffic is being routed to spare regional capacity to reduce errors. No evidence of data loss.
Workaround: Reduce request concurrency and enable exponential backoff retries.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when there is a material change.
```

Jamie (Support): Good. I'll copy that into the support knowledge base and paste a short note into customer tickets.

Sanjay (Oncall): Ops note: we will continue diverting traffic and enable additional worker pools if error rate does not fall below 1% in 20 min. ETA for rollback to normal routing: ~45 mins if trend continues.

Alex (Comms): For exec/press approval: tagging @Elaine (Legal) and Maria. We should get an ack from Product or CEO if we plan to publish to Twitter. Who can escalate?

Maria (Ops): I'll ping CTO for ack and loop in product.

IncidentBot: Reminder — set next update timer for 30 minutes. Use /incident update when posting to status page.

Alex (Comms): Quick checklist before posting public message:
- [ ] Legal review (Elaine)
- [ ] Oncall confirmation of mitigation (Sanjay)
- [ ] Support sync (Jamie)
- [ ] Exec awareness/ok (Maria)

Elaine (Legal): Reviewed. Wording approved with minor tweak: replace "degraded responses" with "reduced response quality".

Alex (Comms): Updated both tweet option and status copy. Final tweet (approved):

"We’re investigating higher latency and timeouts for parts of our text generation API in eu-west and us-west. Traffic is being routed to reduce errors; there is no evidence of data loss. Status: https://status.redwood.ai"

Sanjay (Oncall): Mitigation holding, error rate ~1.3% now. Good to post.

Maria (Ops): CTO acked via DM: go ahead with the status page and tweet.

Alex (Comms): Posting status page now. Will publish tweet in 5 minutes after support posting brief to customers.

Jamie (Support): Sent update to affected customers and added KB note.

Alex (Comms): Tweet posted. Will monitor replies and escalate any press mentions to PR channel.

Sanjay (Oncall): Continuing to watch. Will update thread in 20 min or earlier if changes.

Maria (Ops): Great job everyone — keep thread for final post-incident comms and timeline for postmortem. :thumbsup:
